+"""Intent tests for risk.rolling_vol (M1-T09, RISK-02, TC-05)."""
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk.types import Returns, VolSeries
+from risk.vol import rolling_vol
+
+TESTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+TC05 = TESTS / "fixtures" / "risk" / "TC-05"
+RETURNS_SAMPLE = TESTS / "contracts" / "risk.Returns" / "sample.json"
+
+
+def _load(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def _returns(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=raw["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(raw["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(raw["tickers"]),
+        values={k: tuple(float(x) for x in v) for k, v in raw["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def _tc05() -> tuple[Returns, int, dict[str, Any]]:
+    inp = _load(TC05 / "input.json")
+    return _returns(inp["returns"]), int(inp["window"]), _load(TC05 / "expected.json")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc05_rolling_vol_values_match_within_tolerance() -> None:
+    returns, window, expected = _tc05()
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, window)
+    assert isinstance(vol, VolSeries)
+    tol = expected["tol"]
+    assert set(vol.values) == set(expected["values"])
+    for ticker, want in expected["values"].items():
+        got = vol.values[ticker]
+        assert len(got) == len(want)
+        for g, w in zip(got, want, strict=True):
+            if w is None:
+                assert g is None
+            else:
+                assert g is not None
+                assert g == pytest.approx(w, abs=tol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc05_no_value_until_window_earlier_returns_exist() -> None:
+    returns, window, _ = _tc05()
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, window)
+    for ticker in returns.tickers:
+        series = vol.values[ticker]
+        assert all(v is None for v in series[:window])
+        assert all(v is not None for v in series[window:])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc05_metadata_window_not_annualized_and_aligned() -> None:
+    returns, window, expected = _tc05()
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, window)
+    assert vol.window == expected["window"]
+    assert vol.annualized is expected["annualized"]
+    assert vol.returns == returns
+    for ticker in returns.tickers:
+        assert len(vol.values[ticker]) == len(returns.dates)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_rolling_vol_excludes_current_return() -> None:
+    # Changing the return on date t must not change the volatility at t.
+    returns, window, expected = _tc05()
+    last = len(returns.dates) - 1
+    bumped = dict(returns.values)
+    x = list(bumped["X"])
+    x[last] = x[last] + 1.0
+    bumped["X"] = tuple(x)
+    changed = Returns(
+        base_date=returns.base_date,
+        dates=returns.dates,
+        tickers=returns.tickers,
+        values=bumped,
+    )
+    vol = rolling_vol(changed, window)
+    got = vol.values["X"][last]
+    assert got is not None
+    assert got == pytest.approx(expected["values"]["X"][last], abs=expected["tol"])
+
